landing.heroSubtitle: Complete society management in one platform — handle events, visitor access, community governance, and everything your society needs to thrive.
landing.newMembersHint: New members: register with email — committee activates within 24 hours.
landing.platformSubtitle: From resident events to guest management, governance, vendor tracking, and beyond — all your community's administrative needs in one unified platform.
landing.platformCta: Have an idea for your society? Let your committee know.
landing.eventsDetailSubtitle: Everything below is already live and ready to use.
landing.featuresBookPayDesc: Reserve seats instantly and pay via UPI, card or net banking. Get a QR-code ticket on confirmation.
landing.featuresQrDesc: Show your digital ticket QR code at the gate for a smooth, paperless check-in experience.
landing.featuresSecureDesc: Your data stays within the society. Secured by Keycloak SSO with role-based access control.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Get started in just three steps
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Join your community platform and unlock access to all society services and updates.
landing.howStep1Desc: Register with your email. The committee verifies you're a resident and activates your account within 24 hours.
landing.howStep2Desc: Access events, manage visitors, connect with your community, and stay updated on society news and governance.
landing.howStep3Desc: Book events, invite guests, participate in community decisions, and enjoy all that your society offers.

forgotPasswordPage.title: Forgot Password?
forgotPasswordPage.subtitle: Enter your registered email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPasswordPage.successAlert: Password reset email sent! Check your inbox at {{email}}.
forgotPasswordPage.successHint: Didn't receive it? Check your spam folder or try again in a few minutes.
forgotPasswordPage.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

home.sectionSubtitleGuard: Everything you need for secure and efficient gate operations.
home.sectionSubtitleAll: Explore all the tools available to help your community thrive — from events and visitor management to governance and beyond.

roleWelcome.admin: Full control over your society's operations — manage events, residents, visitors, governance, and everything else.
roleWelcome.committee_member: Create and manage events, oversee community initiatives, and stay connected with your residents.
roleWelcome.resident: Your complete community portal — participate in events, invite guests, access society services, and stay informed.
roleWelcome.security_guard: Verify residents and guests using the QR scanner, manage entry logs, and ensure smooth gate operations.
roleWelcome.sponsor: Track sponsorships, monitor event funding, view community impact, and manage partnerships.
